purpose: Project the final LBE product plan as one persistent provider-neutral governed agent lifecycle. UI, guard packs, Cline mechanics, external integrations and historical clients are subordinate capabilities or projections, not separate product architectures.
authority_rule: Current canonical source/configuration, local validation/runtime evidence, machine governance, active intent and acceptance evidence outrank GPT-K. This file is planning/reference projection only.
final_product_goal: A local persistent LBE agent that can start or resume a workspace/session, reason with a selected provider, discover and request governed capabilities, execute only through LBE authorization and registered adapters, consume ToolReceipts/evidence, replan across turns, deterministically validate completion, persist/recover state, and expose the whole lifecycle through the final HTML LBE interface.
core_invariant: Agent/provider owns cognition; LBE owns capabilities and consequences.

lifecycle_plan.required_product_behavior: Resolve canonical workspace, persisted session, provider/model/profile, mode/policy and installed capabilities; create or restore exactly one product session.
Assemble bounded current workspace/project context and evidence without replacing agent reasoning with a fixed LBE cognitive workflow.
Agent independently chooses investigation strategy, capabilities and next actions; structured ReasoningPlan remains optional/specialist rather than mandatory product cognition.

Every authority-bearing capability request passes through existing policy/R6C authorization and R6E ToolRegistry/GovernedToolOrchestrator; execution returns one correlated ToolReceipt/evidence record.
Registered evidence producers and deterministic completion owners evaluate outcome; provider prose cannot establish terminal completion truth.
Persist session/task state, runtime events, receipts, evidence, recovery/checkpoint state and only evidence-gated validated memory/completion truth.
Agent consumes receipts/evidence, replans or completes; LBE preserves identity, authority boundaries, cancellation/recovery and resume across turns/restarts.

capability_model.workspace_tools: Registered read/mutation/process/Git capabilities execute only through LBE governance.
capability_model.external_integrations: MCP/plugin/subagent/network/hosted services materialize only as preconfigured governed registrations; provider sees schemas, never raw transport authority.
capability_model.guards: Project profile selects approved guard catalog; guards remain deterministic bounded capabilities, not the agent reasoning engine.
capability_model.provider_runtime: Provider/Cline continuation mechanics may be reused behind LBE authority; no provider-native mutation/session/completion authority.
capability_model.memory: Historical/context/validated memory supports reasoning and persistence but does not override current workspace/runtime truth.

product_surface_plan.projection_rule: Conversation/plan surfaces project agent-owned reasoning; evidence surfaces project workspace/knowledge evidence; execution/receipt/validation/history surfaces project LBE-owned truth.
product_surface_plan.current_truth: HTML cockpit implementation, governed adapter wiring and installed acceptance remain pending.
product_surface_plan.historical_surfaces: Textual, Rust/Ratatui and copied Cline/OpenTUI remain implementation/reference history and reuse inputs; they are not the final product authority.

current_active_slice.scope: Adapt only the active TUI request/event/snapshot boundary to existing R6C/R6E authorization, ToolRegistry, GovernedToolOrchestrator, ToolReceipt, evidence, validation and completion owners.
completion_evidence: provider receives only LBE-generated tool definitions

accepted_baseline.rule: Do not reopen these owners or rebuild parallel equivalents unless a separately authorized architecture change proves an unmet requirement.

project_profile_guard_catalog.behavior: lbe start projects project_profile and guard_catalog read-only; CEP callback resolves through the canonical cep pack; startup does not execute guards.
project_profile_guard_catalog.gate_effect: Does not advance or close the active TUI P2/P3 slice.

execution_sequence.scope: Complete only the current TUI P2/P3 governed integration and prove its required evidence.
Checkpoint PASS only when all current-slice proof requirements are met; otherwise remain OPEN/BLOCKED.
Create a separate intent/gate for HTML cockpit implementation and adapter wiring; do not smuggle UI redesign into the current slice.
Bind HTML conversation, plan, evidence, execution, receipt, validation, session/history and control surfaces to existing LBE owners.
Prove the installed HTML product across boot → understand → plan → execute → validate → persist → continue, including resume/cancellation/fail-closed behavior and no duplicate authority.
Only after installed final-product acceptance classify user-ready/release-ready state; publication remains separately governed.

separate_non_product_work.later_rust_ui: Reference/reuse input only; not an active product node.
separate_non_product_work.cline_reference_tree: Reference/archive; preserve only proven reusable LBE-authored seams when separately authorized.
separate_non_product_work.branches_stashes_state: Classify/retain/clean under separate hygiene/retention work; never bundle into product implementation.

final_acceptance_predicate: agent/provider independently reasons and chooses registered capabilities
all authority-bearing execution is authorized and dispatched by LBE
deterministic validation alone establishes completion truth
final HTML interface truthfully projects the same runtime owners without duplicate authority
installed user flow proves the full lifecycle at the exact accepted revision
